description: This file defines the OrdersProvider class, which manages fetching and providing purchase data for the orders page in a Flutter app. It extends ChangeNotifier to allow for state updates and interacts with the PurchasesService to load purchase data with pagination support.

classes.name: OrdersProvider
classes.description: A provider class for fetching and managing purchase data, notifying listeners on data load or changes.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronously loads purchase data from the PurchasesService, updating the internal page state and notifying listeners before and after the fetch.
